definitions: A feminine given name, a diminutive of Corinne or Cordelia.
A masculine given name, a diminutive of Corey.
Gerty Cori, a biochemist and Nobel laureate.
Carl Cori, a biochemist and Nobel laureate, husband of Gerty Cori.
examples: Cori is a lovely name for a girl.
Cori was named after his grandfather.
The Cori family immigrated from Italy.
Gerty Cori made significant contributions to biochemistry.
Carl Cori collaborated with his wife on important research.
